title: Core and the Squire owner's folder kept apart
iWant: my folder (my profile, memory, files, my Squire's name and what it built for me) kept apart from Squire's own core
soThat: replacing Squire's core can never change or lose anything of mine

acceptanceCriteria.description: Replacing Squire's core never touches the Squire owner's folder or what Squire built for the Squire owner.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner's folder holding a profile, memory, files, the Squire's name and things Squire built for the Squire owner
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire's core is laid down again, or replaced with a different core
acceptanceCriteria.then: The Squire owner's folder hashes the same before and after: none of its files is changed, removed or rewritten.

description: The layout on the Mac: core in its own place, replaced whole; the Squire owner's folder apart from it. This story carries the foundation part of the promise that updates never touch the Squire owner's folder; the update and rollback part is a criterion of the updates story.
